decisions.reason: As a close extension of core vessel management with no negative signals, this option remains valuable and cheap to keep.
Building on established crew operations, this travel option retains upside and requires little additional investment, so it is kept open.
The online portal is a low-cost digital option with unresolved but promising prospects, justifying keeping it while monitoring results.
The mobile app is an inexpensive option on digital service growth and uncertainty remains high enough to justify keeping it open.
